KRMN.headline: Karman Holdings Inc. (KRMN) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
KRMN.description: Karman Holdings Inc. (KRMN) reported Q3 earnings of $0.19 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.16, with revenues of $201.62 million exceeding expectations by 2.08%. The company has surpassed earnings estimates in 3 of the last 4 quarters and revenue estimates in all 4 quarters. Despite strong earnings performance, KRMN shares have declined 53.3% year-to-date versus the S&P 500's 12.3% gain. The stock holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating with favorable estimate revision trends.

KRMN.headline: Karman Holdings Inc. (KRMN) Reports Q3 Earnings: What Key Metrics Have to Say
KRMN.description: Karman Holdings Inc. (KRMN) reported Q3 2026 revenue of $201.62 million, up 65.6% year-over-year, beating consensus estimates by 2.08%. EPS of $0.19 exceeded expectations by 18.75%. The company showed strong performance across most business segments, though Space and Launch revenue fell short of analyst estimates. KRMN has gained 8.9% over the past month and holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

OKLO.headline: Not Oklo. Not X-Energy. This SMR Stock Just Signed a Contract to Start Building Reactor Components.
OKLO.description: NuScale Power signed a manufacturing agreement with Doosan Enerbility to begin fabrication of key reactor components for its small modular reactors. The deal secures long-lead nuclear components needed for commercial deployment in the early 2030s. However, NuScale still lacks major commercial customer commitments, unlike competitors X-Energy, making it a speculative investment despite its NRC approval advantage.

OKLO.headline: Oklo Inc. (OKLO) Reports Q3 Loss, Lags Revenue Estimates
OKLO.description: Oklo Inc. reported a quarterly loss of $0.28 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.29 loss, with revenues of $1.86 million. However, the stock has declined 73.2% year-to-date, significantly underperforming the S&P 500's 7.4% gain. The company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revisions, with expectations for continued underperformance in the near term.

OKLO.headline: Better Nuclear Energy Stock to Buy After the Sell-Off: Oklo vs. BWX Technologies
OKLO.description: Nuclear energy stocks have experienced significant sell-offs in 2026, with Oklo down 86% and BWX Technologies down 45% from their highs. The article compares the two companies, concluding that BWX Technologies is the better buy due to its established military contracts, diversified revenue streams, and commercial opportunities in small modular reactors. Oklo, while promising, remains pre-revenue with no NRC-approved reactor design and is years away from operations.

OKLO.headline: Mine, Enrich, Build, Operate: Which Link in the Nuclear Supply Chain Is the Best Stock Right Now?
OKLO.description: With electricity demand projected to grow 60% between 2025-2045, nuclear power is increasingly important. The article analyzes different investment options across the nuclear supply chain: Oklo (SMR builder), Cameco (uranium producer), NextEra Energy (nuclear utility), and Constellation Energy (nuclear operator). For most investors, NextEra and Constellation offer the best risk-reward balance, with NextEra suited for conservative income investors and Constellation for growth investors.

IONQ.headline: IONQ Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, 2026 Sales View Raised, Stock Up
IONQ.description: IonQ reported Q3 2026 revenues of $173.8 million, up 336% year-over-year and beating estimates by 19%. The company raised its 2026 revenue outlook to $505-$515 million from $450-$460 million, driven by strong quantum computing demand and the SkyWater acquisition. Combined backlog reached $1.2 billion. However, adjusted EBITDA losses widened significantly, and the company carries a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) rating due to elevated operating expenses and profitability concerns.

IONQ.headline: New Strong Sell Stocks for November 6th
IONQ.description: Three companies have been added to the Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) list due to significant downward revisions in earnings estimates over the past 60 days. Drilling Tools International saw a 60% downward revision, while Iochpe-Maxion and IonQ experienced 11.1% and 13.3% downward revisions respectively.

IONQ.headline: IonQ, Inc. (IONQ) Reports Q3 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
IONQ.description: IonQ reported a quarterly loss of $0.29 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.30 loss, with revenues of $173.83 million surpassing expectations by 19.03%. However, the company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revision trends, and shares have underperformed the S&P 500 by 46.5% year-to-date. The stock is expected to underperform the market in the near term.

IONQ.headline: Rigetti Q3 Earnings: Will Commercial Progress Translate Into Growth?
IONQ.description: Rigetti Computing is expected to report Q3 2026 results on November 10, with investors scrutinizing whether its expanding order pipeline translates into revenue growth. The company expects to recognize an $8.4 million C-DAC order in Q4 pending installation and acceptance testing. Key focus areas include updates on system deliveries, the $100 million Department of Commerce funding, and progress toward the 99.5% two-qubit gate fidelity target for its 108-qubit Cepheus-1 system by end of 2026.

IONQ.headline: IonQ vs. SoundHound AI: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
IONQ.description: The article compares two emerging technology stocks: IonQ, a quantum computing leader with 201.9% revenue growth but significant losses, and SoundHound AI, a voice technology company with 99.4% revenue growth and a clearer path to profitability. While both are high-growth plays on AI trends, the author recommends SoundHound AI for 2027 due to the larger addressable market for AI ($1.9 trillion by 2032) versus quantum computing ($17.8 billion by 2034), and SoundHound's more mainstream commercial

IREN.headline: IREN Q1 Earnings Call Highlights AI Growth and Deployment Delays
IREN.description: IREN Limited reported Q1 FY2027 results with AI cloud revenues of $200 million (182% sequential growth) and a $20 billion revenue backlog. However, the company pushed its $4 billion operating ARR target from December 2026 to January 2027 due to customer-requested design changes and supplier delays. Management also reduced capital expenditure plans to $15 billion for the remainder of fiscal 2027, citing financing conditions rather than weakening demand. The company carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell)

IREN.headline: The Biggest Stock Winners and Losers From the Midterm Elections
IREN.description: Following the midterm elections, certain stocks are positioned to benefit or suffer based on potential policy shifts. Retailers like Amazon, Shopify, and e.l.f. Beauty could gain from tariff rollbacks, while neoclouds like Space Exploration Technologies and other data center companies face headwinds from tougher permitting. Palantir Technologies may see slower government growth depending on administrative changes.

IREN.headline: As Democrats Take Control of Congress, Warren Buffett Has a Timely Warning for Investors
IREN.description: Following Democrats' 2026 midterm victory, Wall Street rallied with the Dow surging over 1,500 points. However, market sectors diverged sharply: AI hyperscalers like Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Meta surged, while semiconductor and data center stocks plunged amid concerns about tighter AI infrastructure oversight. Warren Buffett's investment philosophy advises against letting political uncertainty drive portfolio decisions, emphasizing that long-term business fundamentals should guide invest

SITM.headline: SITM Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Demand and Supply Constraints
SITM.description: SiTime Corporation (SITM) reported Q3 revenues of $298.7 million, exceeding expectations, with Q4 guidance of $331-$341 million. AI networking demand drove 202% growth in core communications revenues to $127.3M. The company's acquired Timing Products Division contributed $86.3M in revenues. However, wafer constraints are expected to persist through 2027, and the company faces supply chain challenges despite a strong $10B opportunity funnel.

SITM.headline: SiTime (SITM) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
SITM.description: SiTime reported Q3 2026 earnings of $4.01 per share, beating consensus estimates by 17.60%, with revenues of $298.67 million up significantly year-over-year. The company has consistently exceeded expectations over the last four quarters. However, the stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market. Plug Power is expected to report results on November 9 with anticipated quarterly losses.

RKLB.headline: Rocket Lab Stock Has Lost About 70% From Its Record. Is It Finally a Buy?
RKLB.description: Rocket Lab stock has plummeted 70% from its May 2026 peak to around $46, trading at 30x sales compared to 38x just weeks earlier. While the company shows strong revenue growth and a record $2.36 billion backlog, concerns persist: Neutron reusable rocket's first launch has been delayed to 2027, and management forecasts adjusted EBITDA losses will widen significantly in Q3 2026. The analyst suggests waiting for Monday's earnings report before considering a small position.

RKLB.headline: What Tom Gardner Said About Days Like This
RKLB.description: Following a significant market downturn (S&P 500 down 4.36%, Nasdaq down 5.52%), Tom Gardner shares five investment principles for navigating volatility: expect 10-15% pullbacks as normal, move in stages rather than making dramatic trades, favor quality companies with lower return expectations, maintain a diversified portfolio of 50+ companies, and ensure adequate emergency funds to treat market declines as buying opportunities.

RKLB.headline: Ducommun (DCO) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
RKLB.description: Ducommun (DCO) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $1.21 per share, beating consensus estimates of $1.06 and surpassing revenue expectations at $227.02 million. The aerospace-defense supplier has outperformed the market by 64.3% year-to-date. However, the stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

RKLB.headline: Why Rocket Lab Stock Plunged 15% in October and Why Its Decline Might Be Short-Lived
RKLB.description: Rocket Lab's stock fell 21.5% in October after the company announced a delay in its Neutron rocket's inaugural launch from late 2024 to 2027 due to manufacturing issues with carbon fiber propellant domes. However, management has since corrected the problem and completed inspection of a new propellant dome. Despite the setback, the company achieved its 99th successful Electron rocket launch and continues progressing toward becoming an end-to-end space company through its planned acquisition of Ir

RKLB.headline: Intuitive Machines and Rocket Lab: A Comparison of Spiking Sales Versus Steady Revenue
RKLB.description: Intuitive Machines experienced a dramatic revenue spike in 2026 after two years of flat performance, driven by government contracts and acquisitions, while Rocket Lab demonstrated consistent quarter-over-quarter growth with diversified revenue streams. The revenue gap between the two space companies is narrowing, though Rocket Lab maintains a larger absolute revenue base and more predictable growth trajectory.

APP.headline: Kaplan Fox Reminds AppLovin Corporation (NASDAQ: APP) Investors of an Approaching Securities Class Action Deadline on November 16, 2026
APP.description: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation for investors who purchased securities between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026. The complaint alleges that AppLovin made false statements about its generative AI video creative feature experiencing significant development delays and overstated improvements to its AI models. The stock fell 12.65% on July 13, 2026 and 19.66% on August 6, 2026 following negative analyst reports and disappointing earnings guidance.

APP.headline: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AppLovin Corporation Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
APP.description: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims that between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026, the company made false or misleading statements regarding its generative AI video creative feature, overstating AI model improvements and the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition. Investors who purchased AppLovin securities during this period are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 1

APP.headline: Unity Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Vector Strength and Margin Gains
APP.description: Unity Software exceeded earnings expectations with Q3 adjusted EPS of 44 cents (vs. 34-cent estimate) and 32.2% revenue growth to $622.1M. The company achieved its first GAAP profit since IPO with strong performance from its AI-powered Unity Vector advertising platform, which saw 126% year-over-year revenue growth. Adjusted EBITDA margins expanded significantly to 41% from 23%, while Q4 guidance projects continued acceleration with 65-67% Strategic revenue growth.

APP.headline: AppLovin Surges on Strong Q3 Results, Upbeat Guidance: ETFs in Focus
APP.description: AppLovin shares jumped 28% after reporting better-than-expected third-quarter earnings ($4.30 EPS vs. $4.04 expected) and revenue of $2.18 billion. The company issued strong fourth-quarter guidance of $2.37-$2.40 billion, well above consensus estimates. Analysts raised price targets, with BTIG targeting $450 and Needham at $475, suggesting significant upside. However, the stock remains down 43.7% year-to-date, and its price/sales ratio of 11.95X exceeds industry averages, raising valuation conce

APP.headline: APP Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Model Gains and Growth Outlook
APP.description: AppLovin (APP) reported Q3 2026 revenues of $2.18 billion, up 55% year-over-year, driven by new AI models that improved advertising performance. The company forecasts Q4 revenues of $2.365-$2.395 billion with 43-44% growth and EBITDA margins of 84-85%. Gaming ad revenues grew nearly 50%, while consumer ad spending surged triple digits. Management maintains a long-term annual growth target of approximately 30% and generated $1.4 billion in quarterly free cash flow.

APP.headline: HAGENS BERMAN, NATIONAL SECURITIES LAW FIRM, Reminds AppLovin Corporation (NASDAQ: APP) Investors of Class Action and November 16, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline
APP.description: Hagens Berman is investigating AppLovin Corporation for alleged securities law violations, claiming the company misled investors about the readiness and performance of its AI models and self-service ad tools. AppLovin's stock plummeted 19.6% on August 6, 2026, after the company reported missed revenue estimates and acknowledged significant developmental delays in its generative AI video tools. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 16, 2026.

APP.headline: ROSEN, LEADING TRIAL ATTORNEYS, Encourages Duolingo, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - DUOL
APP.description: Several securities class action lawsuits have been filed against major companies. Duolingo faces allegations of misleading statements regarding user growth metrics and product quality degradation from AI-generated content. Coastal Financial faces scrutiny over BaaS credit risk management with shares down 43%. AppLovin, Better Home & Finance, and LKQ are also subject to ongoing investigations and class actions with various lead plaintiff deadlines in November and December 2026.

APP.headline: AppLovin Turns 81% of New Sales Into Profit: Rapid Earnings Reaction
APP.description: AppLovin reported strong Q3 2026 results with 55% revenue growth to $2.18 billion and 72% net income growth to $1.44 billion. The ad platform converted 81% of new revenue into operating income despite doubling research spending. However, free cash flow growth lagged earnings growth due to higher tax payments. Q4 guidance projects continued momentum with steady margins.
